description: Computes on-canvas coordinates (top/left/width/height) for a group of elements on both breakpoints. Modes: 'center' (one box centered on the canvas), 'row' (N boxes in a centered horizontal row on desktop, stacked into one column on mobile), 'grid' (N uniform cells in `cols` columns, stacked on mobile), 'stack' (a vertical list down the content column). Respects the page margins (content column 80–880 on desktop and 20–400 on mobile by default). Returns one box per item in input order, plus `notes` for off-canvas or over-wide inputs. Pure computation: no credentials, no network.

align.description: Horizontal alignment of the block within the canvas. Default center.

canvasDesktop.description: Desktop canvas width. Default 960 (use 1200 for wide pages).

canvasMobile.description: Mobile canvas width. Default 420 (use 360 to match a narrow design).

count.description: Uniform shortcut: number of identical boxes (use with itemWidth/itemHeight).

gap.description: Horizontal gap between row/grid items (px). Default 24.

items.description: Explicit per-item sizes in order (row/stack may vary sizes). Provide this OR count+itemWidth+itemHeight.

marginDesktop.description: Desktop page margin / content inset. Default 80.

marginMobile.description: Mobile page margin / content inset. Default 20.

mobileItemWidth.description: Stacked-mobile item width (row/grid). Default = mobile content width.

mode.description: Layout pattern. center=one box; row=horizontal row (stacks on mobile); grid=cols×rows (stacks on mobile); stack=vertical list.

rowGap.description: Vertical gap between grid rows / stacked items (px). Default = gap.

top.description: Desktop start y inside the section (px). Default 0.

name: layout
